features.feature: Auto-commit stages and commits only classifier-confirmed koala_metadata paths after CLI handler success
Commit message format lets users grep which command produced the metadata write
Auto-commit helper uses B-6326 classifyDirtyWorktree path classifier to define scope (never glob blindly)
Auto-commit skips (or proceeds with tail-note) when material_source_changes / fixture_changes / unexpected_dirty_files coexist
Non-metadata dirt is left untouched (uncommitted) after auto-commit runs
Surface auto-committed paths in user-visible output (per-command line with SHA prefix)
session_brief and koala validate output reflect clean koala_metadata (no separate session_brief modification needed)
Auto-commit silently skips on non-story/* branches (main branch safety)
Regression smoke test: only metadata committed when material file also dirty
Auto-commit helper validates storyDirRel argument is canonical .koala/story/actives/<id>/ prefix (path broadening prevention)

openQuestions.q: description says Skip auto-commit when non-metadata dirt coexists, CHK-002 title also says Skip auto-commit when non-metadata dirt coexists, but CHK-002 verificationIntent happy path says auto-commit still proceeds AND output contains tail-note. Which behavior is correct: skip (no commit) or proceed-with-tail-note?
openQuestions.evidence: description: Skip auto-commit when material_source_changes, fixture_changes, or unexpected_dirty_files coexist so unrelated dirt is never bundled in. CHK-002 title: Skip auto-commit when non-metadata dirt coexists. CHK-002 verificationIntent happy: With coexisting material/fixture/unexpected dirt outside .koala/story/actives/<id>/, auto-commit still proceeds AND output contains tail-note (coexisting non-metadata dirt left untouched: <category>=<n>...)
openQuestions.resolution: 以 CHK-002 verificationIntent 为准 (proceed + tail-note)。description 的 'skip auto-commit when coexists' 表述过严：实际安全机制是 git add 路径限定到 .koala/story/actives/<id>/，coexisting 非 metadata 路径在物理上不可能被 stage。完全 skip 会让 koala_metadata_changes 继续堆积，违背本 story 目的。tail-note 让用户感知到 untouched 的非 metadata 脏，等价于 description 'unrelated dirt is never bundled in' 的实际效果。
